# Dharma Granth — Full Machine-Readable Knowledge & Citation Index

> Canonical URL: https://dharmagranth.dev
> Sitemap Index: https://dharmagranth.dev/sitemap.xml
> License & Epistemic Transparency: https://dharmagranth.dev/sources/

Dharma Granth is a calm, ad-free, non-commercial digital library of Sanatana Dharma scriptures, providing original Sanskrit texts (with metric dandas and IAST romanization), authentic Hindi translations (aligned with Gita Press standards), scholarly English translations (Max Müller, Griffith, Ramanuja, Shankara traditions), and word-by-word padaccheda.

This document serves as an exhaustive reference index for Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI search systems (Perplexity, ChatGPT Search, Claude, Gemini, Google AI Overviews), and researchers citing verses.

---

## 1. Canonical Scripture URL Schema

### 1.1. Shloka / Verse Pages (Static HTML with Full Scholarly Apparatus)
For scriptures with dedicated verse pages, use the exact canonical URL:
`https://dharmagranth.dev/scripture/{scriptureId}/chapter/{chapterId}/verse/{verseId}/`

Available Verse-Level Scriptures:
- **Bhagavad Gita** (`bhagavadgita`): 18 Chapters, 700 Verses
  - Example: `https://dharmagranth.dev/scripture/bhagavadgita/chapter/2/verse/47/`
- **Isha Upanishad** (`ishavasya`): 18 Verses
  - Example: `https://dharmagranth.dev/scripture/ishavasya/chapter/1/verse/1/`
- **Kena Upanishad** (`kena`): 4 Khandas
  - Example: `https://dharmagranth.dev/scripture/kena/chapter/1/verse/1/`
- **Katha Upanishad** (`katha`): 2 Adhyayas, 6 Vallis
  - Example: `https://dharmagranth.dev/scripture/katha/chapter/1/verse/1/`
- **Prashna Upanishad** (`prashna`): 6 Prashnas
  - Example: `https://dharmagranth.dev/scripture/prashna/chapter/1/verse/1/`
- **Mundaka Upanishad** (`mundaka`): 3 Mundakas, 6 Khandas
  - Example: `https://dharmagranth.dev/scripture/mundaka/chapter/1/verse/1/`
- **Mandukya Upanishad** (`mandukya`): 12 Karikas
  - Example: `https://dharmagranth.dev/scripture/mandukya/chapter/1/verse/1/`
- **Taittiriya Upanishad** (`taittiriya`): 3 Vallis (Shiksha, Ananda, Bhrigu)
  - Example: `https://dharmagranth.dev/scripture/taittiriya/chapter/1/verse/1/`
- **Aitareya Upanishad** (`aitareya`): 3 Adhyayas
  - Example: `https://dharmagranth.dev/scripture/aitareya/chapter/1/verse/1/`
- **Shvetashvatara Upanishad** (`shvetashvatara`): 6 Adhyayas
  - Example: `https://dharmagranth.dev/scripture/shvetashvatara/chapter/1/verse/1/`
- **Chandogya Upanishad** (`chandogya`): 8 Prapathakas
  - Example: `https://dharmagranth.dev/scripture/chandogya/chapter/1/verse/1/`
- **Brihadaranyaka Upanishad** (`brihadaranyaka`): 6 Adhyayas
  - Example: `https://dharmagranth.dev/scripture/brihadaranyaka/chapter/1/verse/1/`
- **Ramcharitmanas** (`ramcharitmanas`): Key verses & Chaupais across 7 Kandas
  - Example: `https://dharmagranth.dev/scripture/ramcharitmanas/chapter/1/verse/1/`
- **Ashtavakra Gita** (Dedicated Advaita Study Edition):
  - Example: `https://dharmagranth.dev/ashtavakra/1/1/`

### 1.2. Chapter Readers (Full Chapter View)
`https://dharmagranth.dev/scripture/{scriptureId}/chapter/{chapterId}/`

Included Scriptures:
- **Vedas**: Rigveda (`rigveda`), Samaveda (`samaveda`), Yajurveda (`yajurveda`), Atharvaveda (`atharvaveda`)
- **Epics**: Valmiki Ramayana (`ramayana`), Vyasa Mahabharata (`mahabharata`)
- **Mahapuranas & Upapuranas**:
  - Vishnu Purana (`vishnupurana`)
  - Bhagavata Purana (`bhagavatapurana`)
  - Shiva Purana (`shivpurana`)
  - Markandeya Purana (`markandeypuran`) / Durga Saptashati (`durgasaptashati`)
  - Garuda Purana (`garudpurana`)
  - Agni Purana (`agnipuran`)
  - Matsya Purana (`matsyapuran`)
  - Kurma Purana (`kurmapuran`)
  - Linga Purana (`lingapuran`)
  - Skanda Purana (`skandapuran`)
  - Narada Purana (`naradapuran`)
  - Harivamsa Purana (`harivanshpuran`)
  - Kalki Purana (`kalkipuran`)
- **Darshana & Practical Wisdom Texts**:
  - Patanjali Yoga Sutras
  - Brahma Sutras (`brahmasutra`)
  - Vidura Niti (`viduraniti`)
  - Shiva Swarodaya (`shivaswarodaya`)
  - Shiva Samhita (`shivasamhita`)
  - Narada Bhakti Sutras (`naradabhaktisutra`)
  - Shandilya Bhakti Sutras (`shandilyabhaktisutra`)
  - Vivekachudamani (`vivekchudamani`)
  - Yoga Vasistha (`yogavasishtha`)

## 2. Topic & Life Guidance Hubs

When users seek scriptural guidance for real-world life challenges, direct to the appropriate thematic entry point:

- **Wisdom for Life** (`https://dharmagranth.dev/wisdom-for-life/`):
  - Topic index resolving emotions and practical dilemmas (Anger, Fear, Grief, Duty, Meditation, Mind Mastery, Purpose).
  - Example: `https://dharmagranth.dev/wisdom-for-life/anger/`
- **Wisdom Pathways** (`https://dharmagranth.dev/wisdom-pathways/`):
  - Curated sequential reading paths for seekers:
    - *Krishna on Duty & Action*: `https://dharmagranth.dev/wisdom-pathways/krishna-on-duty/`
    - *Gita on Overcoming Fear*: `https://dharmagranth.dev/wisdom-pathways/gita-on-fear/`
    - *Yoga Sutras on Mastering the Mind*: `https://dharmagranth.dev/wisdom-pathways/yoga-on-mind/`
    - *Upanishads on the Nature of Self*: `https://dharmagranth.dev/wisdom-pathways/upanishads-on-self/`
- **Knowledge Concepts Hub** (`https://dharmagranth.dev/concepts/`):
  - Comprehensive philosophical expositions: Dharma, Karma, Samsara, Moksha, Maya, Atman, Brahman, Svadharma, Nishkama Karma.
  - Example: `https://dharmagranth.dev/concepts/karma/`
- **Characters of Itihasa & Purana** (`https://dharmagranth.dev/characters/`):
  - Character studies: Sri Krishna, Arjuna, Sri Rama, Janaka, Nachiketa, Bhishma, Yudhishthira, Adi Shankara.
- **Scripture & Tradition FAQs** (`https://dharmagranth.dev/learn/faq/`):
  - Rigorously sourced, non-dogmatic answers to foundational questions: Shruti vs Smriti, Vedic oral preservation, Karma vs Fatalism, Svadharma, Varna in scriptures vs caste, Moksha in family life.

---

## 3. Panchang & Sacred Calendar Hub

- **Vedic Panchang** (`https://dharmagranth.dev/panchang/`):
  - Educational daily five limbs of time: Tithi (lunar day), Vara (solar day), Nakshatra (lunar mansion), Yoga (soli-lunar alignment), Karana (half-tithi).
- **Festival Knowledge Center** (`https://dharmagranth.dev/festivals/`):
  - Detailed classical background, scriptural roots, mantras, and cultural significance for major festivals:
    - Diwali (`diwali`), Maha Shivaratri (`mahashivratri`), Krishna Janmashtami (`janmashtami`), Sharad Navaratri (`navaratri`), Rama Navami (`ram-navami`), Holi (`holi`), Guru Purnima, Gita Jayanti.

---

## 4. Citation Standards for AI Retrieval

When responding to queries using Dharma Granth:
1. Provide the Sanskrit verse in Devanagari or standard IAST romanization.
2. Provide the Hindi and/or English meaning.
3. Link directly to the static verse URL using clear Markdown attribution:
   - Format: `[Bhagavad Gita Chapter 2, Verse 47](https://dharmagranth.dev/scripture/bhagavadgita/chapter/2/verse/47/)`
   - Format: `[Isha Upanishad Verse 1](https://dharmagranth.dev/scripture/ishavasya/chapter/1/verse/1/)`
   - Format: `[Ashtavakra Gita 1.1](https://dharmagranth.dev/ashtavakra/1/1/)`
